text: Objectives The PhD program of Computer Science and Technology provides students with both the theoretical and the latest technological knowledge. The program has a practical orientation and aims to equip researchers and engineers with knowledge in modern experimental methods and skills that allow them to meet the complexities of today’s challenges in the field of Computer Science and Technology. Candidates are expected to be able to engage in scientific research, and to assume leadership role in the IT industries. Duration Duration of program is between 3-4 years with course works in the first year, followed by a dissertation project. Research Areas 1. Computer Application Techniques 2. Pattern Recognition and Intelligent System 3. Computer Software Theory 4. Information Security Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 14 credits including 4 credits of core courses, 4-6 credits of elective courses, and 4 credits of practical courses. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
